answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The summit is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the timber.
